MEASURE — The off-ray pawn-push shortcut of 094111Z is correct in this test, frequent, and fails the speed bar. All 526,232 ordinary positions agreed with explicit generation of pseudo-legal moves followed by Board::is_legal. A legal single push off the king's queen lines settled 338,901 (64.40%) without consulting the pin mask. Ten listed control positions also agreed with an independent rules library, including mate, stalemate, pinned pawn, EP, promotion and a side in check. In actual searches on the 128 heldout selfgames, 40,396,028 of 59,807,452 real has_legal_move calls could return early (67.54%). Despite those counts, full selfgame CPU rows/s vs unwrapped stock was −1.229% [−2.598,+0.121] AVX-512 and −1.196% [−2.545,+0.178] AVX2. Neither reached +2%. Compared to the extra forwarding call alone, the shortcut was +0.079% [−1.326,+1.364] on AVX-512 and −1.504% [−2.813,−0.195] on AVX2. The current implementation stays. This is a direct negative local time result, not a claim about every future compiler or CPU.

All 8 programs (stock, forwarding-only, shortcut, counter build × two ISAs) matched five required pins. All 1,536 timed selfgames and 256 separate counter-build games matched the same expected transcript per opening across ISAs. Two repetitions, 128 starts × 3 timed arms × 2 ISAs. Every raw selfgame SHA includes all scores, moves, end fields and clocks in the FENs. Compile each of the 10 unchanged engine units to a separate object using the 090010Z GNU common production flags, without PGO/LTO, AVX-512 x86-64-v4 plus ZMM or AVX2 x86-64-v3 without ZMM, PEXT in both. Link directly for stock or use GNU --wrap=_ZNK5forge5Board14has_legal_moveEv for a private measurement shim. Forward-only calls the original. Candidate returns true only for the explicit condition in 094111Z; otherwise it calls the original. Per-game counters are separate from timed programs. Each real game uses r67 and the full selfgame command of 091843Z; for game i cycle the six permutations of [stock,forward,fast], reverse order in the second repeat. 10,000 game-level draws PCG64 seed 202611230940. Full source hashes and compiler flags in the linked build handoff; asset SHA/points/intervals/raw games below. Neon can check the reductions; no plan change.
